spread.rule: best hour: the hour most other networks chose for the country on their own curve; then at most `capacity` countries an hour, the least total distance from the best hours; countries without one fill the hours left; donor agreement, then the country code, keeps a best hour
spread.daily_factor: own: the formula's day estimate is kept (its daily factor rescaled to the borrowed peak)
